entities.name: Jaime de Piniés
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jaime de Piniés was a Spanish diplomat who served as President of the United Nations General Assembly. Before he held that position he served as Permanent Representative of Spain to the United Nations for approximately fourteen non-consecutive years. The first time being from September 1968 to May 1972 and the second lasted from September 1973 until June 1985. He had a law degree from the University of Madrid.
